run_qualification_tool: run the qualification_tool.py script to print HTML for a Mechanical Turk HIT page
render_qualification_html: render the HTML qualification tool page with three command question blocks
generate_css_script: generate the CSS_SCRIPT template that hides word elements based on variable presence
generate_before_template: generate the BEFORE HTML template with Bootstrap styling and HIT instructions
generate_after_template: generate the AFTER HTML template with closing tags, CSS styles, and JS scripts
